notes: Stories validated; no duplicates; aligned to schema, logic, API/UI, tests, integration.

stories.title: Clinical Trial Snapshot Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define canonical trial snapshot schema with strict enums (phase/status), required vs optional fields, URL format constraints, and enforce bidirectional parity between Pydantic models and service output.

stories.title: Clinical Trial Data Extraction and Normalization Logic
stories.description: Implement extraction and normalization including enum mapping, structured locations (city/state/site), eligibility normalization, travel distance/duration integration from Google Routes, and deterministic fallback handling for missing or partial ClinicalTrials.gov fields.

stories.title: Evaluate Care Facade and API Exposure for Trial Snapshot
stories.description: Expose trial snapshot via evaluate_care_facade and tool_router with strict schema validation, error handling for upstream failures, and compatibility with tool-use orchestration.

stories.title: Frontend Rendering of Clinical Trial Snapshot
stories.description: Render structured trial snapshot in chat UI with consistent grouping (overview, eligibility, locations), stable field ordering, and enforced URL validation via URL Guardian before display.

stories.title: Clinical Trial Snapshot Unit, Integration, and Contract Tests
stories.description: Develop unit, integration, and contract tests covering schema validation, normalization correctness, facade/API response integrity, UI rendering, URL validation, and null/missing field handling across end-to-end flow.
